title: Last Chance Canyon
text: Last Chance Canyon runs through the El Paso Mountains from Saltdale in the south to Black Mountain in the north. It was added to the National Register of Historic Places on December 5, 1972, and is known as the Last Chance Archaeological District. The canyon includes pictographs, villages, rock shelters, mills, and quarries, along with gold mining camps. The canyon is open to hiking, camping, and four-wheel-drive vehicles in most parts.
